non_applicable_when: The representation has no independent sample axis.
unsupported_when: The feature axis cannot be measured as numeric coordinates.
Fewer than two independent samples are available.
Rank or effective-dimension evidence cannot be computed.
The sample or feature identity is ambiguous.

required_evidence.description: Rank, effective rank, or an equivalent predeclared dimensionality profile.
Variance or singular-value profile bound to the same representation identity.
A non-collapsed reference or counterexample evaluated with the same measurement contract.
A control that distinguishes benign low variance from loss of usable rank.
Representation identity, sample scope, feature axis, and predeclared thresholds.

non_applicable_when: The representation does not expose a measurable feature coordinate axis.
unsupported_when: The sample distribution or feature identity is unavailable.
A variance, covariance, or equivalent directional-activity measure cannot be computed.
Thresholds are chosen after inspecting the target result.

required_evidence.description: Directional variance, covariance spectrum, or an equivalent activity profile.
A threshold or decision rule declared before target evaluation.
An isotropic or otherwise healthy negative control under the same estimator.
Representation identity, sample scope, feature axis, and estimator settings.

non_applicable_when: The representation has no feature coordinates or feature relationship semantics.
unsupported_when: Feature relationships cannot be estimated with a declared method.
The feature basis or sample scope is ambiguous.
A sparse or overcomplete comparison is unavailable where the claim requires it.

required_evidence.description: A predeclared dependence, overlap, or redundancy measure across features.
A sparse, overcomplete, or otherwise explicit comparison that tests the superposition hypothesis.
A randomized or shuffled feature control using the same estimator and sample scope.
A representation expected not to exhibit the claimed redundancy pattern.
Feature identity, sample scope, estimator, and comparison configuration.

non_applicable_when: No declared target labels or target attributes exist.
unsupported_when: Labels are unavailable for an independent evaluation split.
The split, probe capacity, or preprocessing is not declared.
A label-randomization or leakage control cannot be run.

required_evidence.description: Independent train/evaluation split identity and preprocessing provenance.
Held-out probe performance with uncertainty under a declared metric.
A capacity or regularization control that bounds probe expressivity.
Label randomization or permutation control on the same split.
A non-separable or leakage-negative control evaluated by the same probe protocol.

non_applicable_when: No reference and comparison sample distributions are declared.
unsupported_when: Reference and comparison identities cannot be bound to the same representation space.
The density or distance estimator is unavailable or uncalibrated.
Uncertainty or shuffled/null controls are unavailable.

required_evidence.description: Reference and comparison split identities, preprocessing, and representation identity.
Density, distance, or score distribution computed under a declared estimator.
Calibration and uncertainty for the score or threshold decision.
Shuffled, null, or permutation control for the distribution comparison.
A same-distribution or no-drift negative control.

non_applicable_when: No sparse-feature or dictionary representation is being evaluated.
No repeated seed or fit axis exists.
unsupported_when: Feature identities cannot be aligned across repeated fits.
The seed or fit provenance is unavailable.
Sparsity quality and stability cannot be measured separately.

required_evidence.description: Feature stability across at least two independently seeded fits.
A declared feature matching or alignment measure across fits.
Sparsity and reconstruction or selectivity quality for each compared fit.
A seed or initialization control that bounds instability attributable to fitting noise.
A stable or explicitly non-sparse negative control under the same comparison protocol.
Feature basis, seed identities, fit configuration, and sample scope.

non_applicable_when: The representation explicitly has no sequence, time, checkpoint, token, or trajectory axis.
unsupported_when: Sequence or time identity cannot be aligned across observations.
The horizon, step, token, or checkpoint axis is present but its ordering is unavailable.
A null or shuffled sequence control cannot be evaluated.

required_evidence.description: Stable sequence or trajectory identity and alignment across compared observations.
Stepwise or horizon-level drift metric with declared normalization.
A null, shuffled, or deranged sequence control using the same alignment and metric.
A sequence expected not to exhibit the claimed drift pattern.
Repeatability or uncertainty across declared seeds, runs, or repeated trajectories.
